card_limitations: Do not replace exact identity with a permissive wildcard merely to pass verification.
Signing can use OIDC and publish transparency records; no signing or identity flow initiated here.
Not all upstreams publish signatures; keep checksum evidence labeled as such.
candidates.name: cosign

card_limitations: Content hashes prove identity, not data validity or point-in-time correctness.
GitHub canonical repository now resolves to treeverse/dvc; older iterative URLs redirect.
Even metadata can reveal identifiers; review public manifests separately from private data/cache.
candidates.name: DVC
candidates.role: Git-linked hashes, data dependencies and experiment pipelines

card_limitations: Single-node synthetic replay is a prospective smoke check, not high availability or exchange recovery evidence.
Ordering is partition-local; Kafka transactions do not make broker orders, files or all external sinks exactly-once.
GitHub has no current release entries; version/date come from Apache downloads.
candidates.name: data-kafka
candidates.role: Durable partitioned event log for multiple independent consumers

card_limitations: AGPL obligations or commercial license apply to relevant deployments. The lmstudio setting in this profile targets local vLLM; it does not require LM Studio.
Embedding dimension/model changes require deliberate reindexing; no automatic linked-project expansion.
candidates.name: foundation-socraticode
candidates.role: Automatic semantic code indexing and graph context

card_limitations: The client/specification is not a persistent lineage server, scheduler or dataset version store.
Lineage metadata may disclose private dataset names/URIs; never embed credentials or licensed row contents.
candidates.name: data-openlineage
candidates.role: Open job/run/dataset lineage event standard and clients

card_limitations: Current release is BSL-1.1 source-available, not blanket Apache-licensed software.

Pinned license includes an Additional Use Grant while current vendor prose describes paid production/business use; resolve the intended deployment with the licensor instead of assuming unrestricted commercial rights.
Storage version time is not proof of market information availability; do not discard revisions needed for replay.
candidates.name: data-arcticdb
candidates.role: Versioned dataframe storage using LMDB or object storage

card_limitations: No experiments or models were run by this review. The example would only record a synthetic local metric.
Autologging does not capture every data revision, leakage decision or external service cost; avoid unreviewed hosted telemetry and dataset uploads.
candidates.name: data-mlflow
candidates.role: Local experiment runs, parameters, metrics and artifacts

card_limitations: Catalog creation alone would not prove append, multi-writer conflict handling, cross-engine compatibility or time travel.
Snapshot expiry and orphan-file removal must preserve required research/audit versions; storage snapshots do not imply past information availability.
candidates.name: data-iceberg
candidates.role: Open table snapshots and schema/partition evolution

existing_overturn_when: Freeze required universe/history/latency, rights, correction and availability semantics; compare selected providers on representative securities including delistings, ticker reuse and corporate actions, then change the feed/store only when a candidate closes those gaps with auditable records and acceptable measured cost. Add a server or lake only after local throughput/concurrency measurements justify it.
limitations: The authenticated Alpaca receipt covers 25 AAPL SIP/raw daily bars and two corporate actions over five successful pages, not a survivorship-free universe, complete history or real-time feed entitlement.

Numeric corporate-action values matched the frozen probe, but missing dividend currency prevented full cash-unit reconciliation. Original historical availability and complete action coverage remain open.
Three documentary lifecycle cases preserve observed cutoffs and source anchors; retrospective claims do not establish historical as-known eligibility or permanent security identity.
The prior SEC HTTP 403 remains a historical failure. Later corrected acquisition and parsing qualify their selected requests only; no general filing-completeness or strategy-validity claim follows.
SQL, schemas and content hashes cannot repair missing provenance, revised fundamentals, access rights or outcome-selected samples.
The us-equities catalog also tags entries for this taxonomy layer under agents-operations (1), foundation-memory (1); data-research (9) was picked as the primary group by entry count.
requirement: Acquire licensed, source-identifiable US-equity observations; preserve feed, timestamps, identity and corporate actions; produce exact reproducible analytical snapshots and reject data whose historical availability or eligibility is unknown.
requirement_note: The requirement, limitations and existing_overturn_when text is shared by this layer's group; judge fit against the layer title and layer_scope_terms.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
title: Identity, provenance and lineage
